/**
 * Tests that rows are always ordered according to the clear values of the columns, even for the post-ordering done
 * for queries with {@code IN} restrictions and {@code ORDER BY} clauses.
 */
@Test
public void testPostOrdering() throws Throwable {
    createTable("CREATE TABLE %s (k int, c int, v int, PRIMARY KEY (k, c))");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (0, 0, 0)");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (0, 1, 1)");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (1, 0, 3)");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (1, 1, 4)");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (2, 0, 6)");
    execute("INSERT INTO %s (k, c, v) VALUES (2, 1, 7)");
    NativeFunctions.instance.add(NEGATIVE);
    // Test ordering without masking, just for reference
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), row(0, 0, 0), row(0, 1, 1), row(1, 0, 3), row(1, 1, 4), row(2, 0, 6), row(2, 1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), row(0, 0, 0), row(1, 0, 3), row(2, 0, 6), row(0, 1, 1), row(1, 1, 4), row(2, 1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), row(0, 1, 1), row(1, 1, 4), row(2, 1, 7), row(0, 0, 0), row(1, 0, 3), row(2, 0, 6));
    // Test ordering with manually applied masking function, just for reference
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT k, mask_negative(c), v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, mask_negative(c), v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, mask_negative(c), v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6));
    alterTable("ALTER TABLE %s ALTER c MASKED WITH mask_negative()");
    // Test ordering of wildcard queries with masked column
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6));
    // Test ordering of column selection queries with masked column
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT k, c, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, c, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, c, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, -1, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, -1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, -1, 7), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, -0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, -0, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, -0, 6));
    // Test ordering of column selection queries with masked column, without selecting the ordered column
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT k, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, 0), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, 1), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, 3), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, 4), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, 6), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, 6), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, 7));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT k, v FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row(0, 1), // (1, 1, 4)
    row(1, 4), // (2, 1, 7)
    row(2, 7), // (0, 0, 0)
    row(0, 0), // (1, 0, 3)
    row(1, 3), // (2, 0, 6)
    row(2, 6));
    // Test ordering of wildcard JSON queries with masked column
    assertRowsNet(executeNet("SELECT JSON * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2)"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 0}"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 1}"), // (1, 0, 3)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 3}"), // (1, 1, 4)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 4}"), // (2, 0, 6)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 6}"), // (2, 1, 7)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 7}"));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT JSON * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c ASC"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 0}"), // (1, 0, 3)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 3}"), // (2, 0, 6)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 6}"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 1}"), // (1, 1, 4)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 4}"), // (2, 1, 7)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 7}"));
    assertRowsNet(executeNetWithoutPaging("SELECT JSON * FROM %s WHERE k IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY c DESC"), // (0, 1, 1)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 1}"), // (1, 1, 4)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 4}"), // (2, 1, 7)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": -1, \"v\": 7}"), // (0, 0, 0)
    row("{\"k\": 0, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 0}"), // (1, 0, 3)
    row("{\"k\": 1, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 3}"), // (2, 0, 6)
    row("{\"k\": 2, \"c\": 0, \"v\": 6}"));
}

@Test
public void testDescribeVirtualTables() throws Throwable {
    assertRowsNet(executeDescribeNet("DESCRIBE ONLY KEYSPACE system_virtual_schema;"), row("system_virtual_schema", "keyspace", "system_virtual_schema", "/*
" + "Warning: Keyspace system_virtual_schema is a virtual keyspace and cannot be recreated with CQL.
" + "Structure, for reference:
" + "VIRTUAL KEYSPACE system_virtual_schema;
" + "*/"));
    assertRowsNet(executeDescribeNet("DESCRIBE TABLE system_virtual_schema.columns;"), row("system_virtual_schema", "table", "columns", "/*
" + "Warning: Table system_virtual_schema.columns is a virtual table and cannot be recreated with CQL.
" + "Structure, for reference:
" + "VIRTUAL TABLE system_virtual_schema.columns (
" + "    keyspace_name text,
" + "    table_name text,
" + "    column_name text,
" + "    clustering_order text,
" + "    column_name_bytes blob,
" + "    kind text,
" + "    position int,
" + "    type text,
" + "    PRIMARY KEY (keyspace_name, table_name, column_name)
" + ") WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (table_name ASC, column_name ASC)
" + "    AND comment = 'virtual column definitions';
" + "*/"));
}

@Test
public void cliHelpDiff() {
    ToolResult result = jmxtool("help", "diff");
    result.assertOnCleanExit();
    Assertions.assertThat(result.getStdout()).isEqualTo("Usage: jmxtool diff [-hV] [--ignore-missing-on-left]
" + "                    [--ignore-missing-on-right] [-f=format]
" + "                    [--exclude-attribute=exclude_attributes]...
" + "                    [--exclude-object=exclude_objects]...
" + "                    [--exclude-operation=exclud_operations]... [<files>...]
" + "Diff two jmx dump files and report their differences
" + "      [<files>...]      Files to diff
" + "      --exclude-attribute=exclude_attributes
" + "                        Ignores processing specific attributes. Each usage
" + "                          should take a single attribute, but can use this flag
" + "                          multiple times.
" + "      --exclude-object=exclude_objects
" + "                        Ignores processing specific objects. Each usage should
" + "                          take a single object, but can use this flag multiple
" + "                          times.
" + "      --exclude-operation=exclud_operations
" + "                        Ignores processing specific operations. Each usage
" + "                          should take a single operation, but can use this flag
" + "                          multiple times.

" + "                          yaml as format
" + "  -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.

}

@Test
public void testMaybeChangeDocs() {

    String help = "usage: sstablescrub [options] <keyspace> <column_family>
